CAMPAIGN_NAME: Polar bear trace element monitoring across Alaska, Canada and Greenland
PROTOCOL_COMMENT: Polar bear samples collected from native subsistence hunts during 2005-2008. Bears of both sexes aged 2 to 29 years.

CAMPAIGN_NAME: Polar bear trace element monitoring across Alaska, Canada and Greenland
PROTOCOL_COMMENT: Each sample was digested in 0.5 mL of ROP (Reverse Osmosis Purified) water and 1.0 mL of 70% nitric acid overnight at room temperature. The sample was then heated at 100°C for 4 hours and diluted with ROP water to 4 mL.

CAMPAIGN_NAME: Polar bear trace element monitoring across Alaska, Canada and Greenland
PROTOCOL_COMMENT: EPA Method 200.8 with modifications for biological samples. Concentrations measured using ELAN 9000, inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry from Perkin Elmer. CRMs used included Dolt-3, Tort-2, Oyster Tissue 1566b, Bovine Liver 1577a, Bovine Muscle 8414 and Mussel Tissue 2976. Average recoveries ranged from 80.9% for copper to 103.5% for Se.
